notes.title: New version is live!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce a new version of Baron: Fur is gonna fly.

Our main aim with this update has been to add some extra gameplay modes, to add extra variety to how you can play.

The new modes are...

[h2]Paint[/h2]
Two teams fight to paint the most sky. The team that paint's the most, wins.

The longer you stay alive the quicker you can paint, so protecting your team mates is essential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769058/7b68f9c3499a5adb55fc5872eb7571bd37b7a0a4.png[/img]


[h2]Capture the cow[/h2]
Capture the cow to win! The player that holds it the longest wins... but there's a catch, you can't shoot, use your specials or roll while you are holding the cow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769058/f4e3b31c0571381c141ffa711471689c30183eda.png[/img]


[h2]King[/h2]
Everyone works together to get the king. The person that shoots down the king, becomes the new king.

In this mode, only the king can use their special weapon- so you had better be careful while trying to take them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769058/039068cfdc952a594cbece772298b2569a4480e1.png[/img]

[h2]Souvenir[/h2]
This mode is like regular battle, but when players die, they leave behind a coin. The player that collects the most coins wins.

If you're not a sharp shooter you can still win- just let other people do all the shooting while you go around stealing their coins- you'll drive them crazy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769058/a4d03d52c779cead580835c4ced0ba6eeb1f9f05.png[/img]




We've had a lot of fun playing all the new modes, but if we had to chose a favourite, it would probably be Paint mode. It's very strategic, often has exciting ends, and it can also be quite relaxing just painting the sky. Also, if you're playing single player, try playing Paint against the bots... it's quite a fun challenge (If you can win a 1v3 bots game, you can officially count yourself as a skilled pilot!)


[h1]Detailed changes...[/h1]
[list]
[*]4 new gameplay modes.
[*]Steam support for more than 4 Xbox Controllers (Details here: [url=http://baronthegame.com/steamJoystick]baronthegame.com/steamJoystick[/url])
[*]Music less likely to repeat.
[*]New option for tougher bots.
[*]Winner's name is shown at the end of a round.
[*]Extra commentary, particularly in team games.
[*]Fixed bug where 'Pow's could appear on top of each other.
[*]Fixed bug where bots would taunt too much in single player game.
[/list]

[h1]Free soundtrack[/h1]
If you purchased the game before 04 May 2020, then you're entitled to a free copy of the Baron Soundtrack. For more details, please go here: [url=http://baronthegame.com/earlyBuyers]baronthegame.com/earlyBuyers[/url]

notes.title: 关于这游戏要折扣大更新双来袭这件事我必须要让你们知道！
notes.notes:
你是否早早的将《关于天上有毛绒一边开男爵一边打飞机这件事》加入了愿望单，但苦于没有折扣而迟迟没有喜加一。
 你又是否早已购买《关于天上有毛绒一边开男爵一边打飞机这件事》，但无奈游戏迟迟没有更新添加新内容而很久没有打开过游戏。

以上的问题我们都将为你解决，因为：
《关于天上有毛绒一边开男爵一边打飞机这件事》于5月1日22点——5月6日开启限时折扣活动，立减52%，仅需16元。

同时《关于天上有毛绒一边开男爵一边打飞机这件事》将在5月4日23点将迎来重大更新，添加4种全新模式，均可与1-8位玩家一起使用，4种新模式分别是涂料（Paint）、抓牛（Capture the cow）、纪念品（Souvenir）、国王（King）。

涂料（Paint）：
2个团队用“画笔”争夺天空，涂画百分比最高的团队在回合结束时赢得比赛。你存活的越久，您的“画笔”就越宽。
此模式可与其他玩家一起游玩，也可以进行单人模式...玩1对3个敌方机器人是一个有趣的挑战。 （如果你已经掌握了技巧，甚至可以进行到1v7，偷笑……）

抓牛（Capture the cow）：
该模式中有一头牛。玩家可以持有它，持有时间最长的玩家胜利。当您持有牛时，你无法射击或滚动。当你死后，牛会随机移动到某个地方。
为此，玩家需要疯狂地抢夺牛，其次是灵活转身避免所有敌人的火力。

纪念品（Souvenir）：
这就像普通的战斗模式，但是当你死亡时，你会留下一枚硬币。收集最多硬币的玩家获胜。
这种模式对于射击水平不佳的玩家和娱乐玩家都很有趣，因为可能你的水平不如对手，但你仍然可以偷走他们的硬币并赢得比赛。

国王（King）：
该模式中一名玩家会成为国王，其他玩家都在尝试射击他。射杀国王，你便会成为新国王。保持国王的时间最长，就能赢得比赛。最重要的是，国王是最强者，他们会拥有特殊武器，因此，国王在对抗其他玩家时具有很大优势，用于帮助他们存活。国王每次射击时，特殊武器都会改变，所以有一个随机元素不知道接下来会是什么武器，此外，这可能会迫使你使用你并没有掌握的武器。

notes.title: Chinese Players: We are pleased to announce a permanent price drop
notes.notes:
We noticed that some game media and influencers in China are introducing our game. We are surprised and very happy!

Also, we noticed that in China the price is too high, so we will change the price. If you purchased this game already at the original price in China, please send a message to our Chinese publisher, Gamera Game (contact@gameragame.com), and show us a screenshot of your purchase record (like the receipt email, a screenshot of your game library with your id), for a 50% refund.

Of course this is limited to purchases before the permanent price reduction.

Thank you for playing BARON. We hope you have many enjoyable furry battles.
